title: Sign in and find your way around
summary: Browse public information or sign in for your own saved resources and maps.

evidence: server/src/utils/guideOracleKnowledge.js: reviewed original fact objects at b8345be4d2f7a097e81cb03eef64b473abd0cec9

sections.title: Sign in to your existing account
paragraphs: Sign in to reach your own saved resources and maps. Use a sign-in method already linked to your account; staff and admins use this same sign-in form.
steps: Open Sign in and keep the Sign in tab selected.
For email sign-in, enter your Email address and Password, then select Sign in. If Google is already linked to your account, use the Google sign-in option instead.
Wait for the sign-in handoff to return you to the page you requested or to Dashboard. If the handoff offers Continue now, select it to continue.
Open My Directory from the dashboard navigation for your saved resources and My Maps. Use Discover to browse public listings.
notes: Discover and published Shared Maps can be browsed without signing in. Signing in does not give you permission to edit a public resource.
If a Google account needs linking, follow the message and sign in to the existing account first. Register creates an account; it is not an account-recovery step.

If your session has expired, sign in again. If the linked method fails or is unavailable, try another method already linked to the same account or submit a sign-in support report. Never put a password or verification code in chat or a report.

sections.title: Sign in with an already verified WhatsApp number
paragraphs: WhatsApp sign-in needs a number already verified in your CareAround profile and access to that WhatsApp account.
steps: On the Sign in tab, select Sign in with WhatsApp.
Enter the WhatsApp phone number already verified in your profile and confirm that you can use that WhatsApp account on this device.
Select Sign in with WhatsApp to start one attempt. If WhatsApp does not open, use Open WhatsApp when offered.
Send the prefilled message in WhatsApp, then return to CareAround while it checks the attempt. Keep the code within that sign-in flow.
When sign-in finishes, continue to your account. If the attempt expires or fails, use the offered Try again or Use Google/email option rather than starting several attempts at once.
notes: A number that is not verified on an existing account cannot establish access to that account. Sign in with its existing Google/email method first and verify the number in My Profile if needed.
Starting a new registration can create a separate account. If you meant to recover an existing account, stop and use a linked sign-in method or a support report instead.

facts.title: Browse without an account
keywords: need to sign in to browse
facts.message: You can browse public resources in Discover and open a published Shared Map without signing in. Sign in to save resources, create My Maps or copy someone else’s Shared Map into your own My Maps.

facts.title: Help with signing in
facts.message: Try the sign-in method already linked to your account. If your session expired, sign in again. Avoid starting several WhatsApp verification attempts at once. You can report a sign-in problem here without signing in; keep the private recovery code to return to your report. Never send passwords or verification codes.

facts.title: Help with account access
facts.message: The Guide cannot reset a password or change sign-in details. Open Sign in and use a sign-in method already available to your account. If you still cannot access it, submit a support report describing the sign-in problem. Never put a password or verification code in Guide chat or a report.
